why: The count of raw-HTML sinks in rendered source goes from 2 at the merge base to 6: SiteDocument, the document the website's prerender writes and the browser renders again, adds 4 (the boot script that chooses the language, one inline script at the root, the JSON record the page embeds, and the app address's loading picture); GatewayHandOverScript adds 1, which its own record covers; open-vault-file.ts removes 1. Each text is built at build time from the locale list, the shipped loading picture and the build's own facts and holds no vault, URL or user data; the record goes through serializeJsonForHtml. A script child cannot use a plain text child, because React escapes script text and would break the code and the JSON, and the picture is shipped markup.
